title: The Hum
summary: A week after the null crate left town, Saltmouth's radios still catch its frequency — three faint echoes triangulated on the pan, the overlook and the east gate. Ride the triangle, tune in, and find out what a sealed crate wants with a town it already left.

objectives.label: Tune in at the old salt pan
Tune in at the dune overlook
Tune in at the east gate
Bring what you heard back to the garage

offer.text: The crate is three settlements away and yet every radio in Saltmouth clears its throat at dusk on the same frequency. I triangulated three echoes. The Guild's official position is 'weather'. My position rides a bike.
You want me to go stand still in three empty places and listen to a box we got rid of.
When you put it like that it sounds like faith. I'm paying courier rates, not Choir rates. Go.

accept.text: Ketch here. Tamsin flagged me the coordinates. Old pan first, then the overlook, then the gate. Kid — if the static starts answering in words, you ride home and we never discuss it. That's protocol I just invented.
And Varga — take notes. If something impossible is happening, the Guild would like it documented in triplicate.

complete.text: All three echoes, same frequency. They weren't echoes of the crate, Ketch. They were… aimed. Like the crate left a string back to Saltmouth and someone's plucking it.
Get home, kid. Slow on the last stretch. Whatever's humming, it knows the roads now.
Varga. The ledger page from last week — the one no clerk wrote — filled in again tonight. One line, in that same hand nobody owns.
It says: 'VARGA, ASH — ROUTE ASSIGNED.' You don't have a route assigned, Ash. Nobody assigns routes but me. Get some sleep. Bar your door. I'll bill someone.
